Name: Zosa's Buildings
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Some new building recolors brought to you by Zosa﻿!
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Some new building recolors brought to you by [Zosa](https://community.playstarbound.com/members/zosa.979084/)!

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work.  It does not yet include all buildings, though it is structured to support adding more in the future.

DOES NOT WORK WITH 1.4, THE CABIN NEEDS TO BE REDONE

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)﻿.

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CP] Zosa's Buildings folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game once to generate the config file, options are listed below.

5.  Run the game using SMAPI, you're done!
Config Options

*   Lists all buildings currently available.  All have the option to change between "enabled" and "disabled".  All default to "enabled".
